messages:
sasha: FYI alert: multiple long-lived CreateGrant events for KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456 observed in the backup pipeline around 21:12Z. Grants created with Name=\"persistent-backup-grant\" and no GrantTokens. After that we see unexpected PutObject to tenant prefixes. tagging @lee and @arjun.

opsec-bot: detected 6 CreateGrant events for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456 from principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/backup-agent between 2024-06-01T21:11:40Z and 2024-06-01T21:13:05Z. Alert ref: ENCSEC-9001.

lee: can you paste the CloudTrail entry for one of the CreateGrant calls? want to confirm request params.

sasha: pasted one excerpt below (sanitized):
```json
{"eventTime":"2024-06-01T21:12:02Z","eventName":"CreateGrant","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/backup-agent/i-0f1e2d"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456","granteePrincipal":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-agent","operations":["Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey"]},"responseElements":{"grantId":"g-9z8y7x6w","name":"persistent-backup-grant","constraints":null}}
```

arjun: that's the helper fallback behavior. last month we added a retry fallback so if agent sees repeated EIO it requests a persistent grant instead of failing. the code path unfortunately calls create_grant without passing a TTL or using GrantTokens. commit f9a2c3. snippet: 
```python
kms.create_grant(KeyId=key_id, GranteePrincipal=role_arn, Operations=['Encrypt','Decrypt','GenerateDataKey'], Name='persistent-backup-grant')
```

sam: quick find: backup-agent role policy allows s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::archive-main/* with no s3:prefix condition. intended design was prefix-restricted by tenant tag, but condition missing in policy. combo of broad role + persistent grant = cross-tenant write risk.

sasha: immediate mitigation plan: 1) retire the identified grants for key ef12-3456. 2) temporarily disable backup-agent role sessions (revoke tokens). 3) block further uploads by applying an allow-list to S3 bucket policy. 4) roll back the fallback change and push a patch that uses short-lived grantTokens. 5) run a scan for objects written between 21:10-21:20 and list impacted tenant prefixes.

opsec-bot: created ticket ENCSEC-9001: "persistent backup grants + S3 scope gap" assigned to eng-security, eng-sre.

lee: I'll run retire-grant in staging and then prod when we have the patch. retire command I plan to use:
```bash
# retire specific grant
aws kms retire-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456 --grant-id g-9z8y7x6w
# list grants for manual verification
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456
```

eng-sre: staging revoke completed in 8m, smoke tests passed. preparing prod revoke.

sasha: forensics: collect CloudTrail CreateGrant/RetireGrant, AssumeRole logs, S3 access logs and object metadata, and EBS snapshots if any. also check whether any GenerateDataKey calls happened using these grants.

arjun: will open rollback PR now and add tests to ensure create_grant only used via helper that supplies grant_tokens and enforces ephemeral pattern. also adding CI lint rule blocking direct create_grant calls.

sam: updating bucket policy to deny PutObject unless aws:PrincipalArn matches expected uploader pattern and s3:prefix matches tenant placeholder. will roll this concurrently.

opsec-bot: ENCSEC-9001 status -> mitigation-in-progress.

sasha: initial impact scan: writes observed to tenant-7 and tenant-81 prefixes. notifying support for customer outreach drafts.

eng-sre: prod revoke done at 21:39Z. post-revoke monitoring shows no writes after 21:40Z.

sasha: follow-ups: (a) patch & rollback PR (arjun), (b) policy fix (sam), (c) CI lint rule (arjun), (d) detection rule for CreateGrant without grantTokens (sasha). will schedule a 24h postmortem. thanks team. :shield:
